Following sections are missing.  
1\. “What we build” section missing hai  
Ye page ke top half mein hona chahiye.  
Visitor ko immediately pata chalna chahiye ki Jabitsoft actually SaaS mein kya develop karta hai.

What we build for SaaS companies  
**SaaS Product Development**  
From MVPs to mature multi-tenant platforms.  
**Multi-tenant Architecture**  
Secure architecture designed around organizations, users, roles, and data isolation.  
**Customer & Admin Portals**  
Dashboards, onboarding, account management, permissions, and internal operations.  
**Subscriptions & Billing**  
Plans, subscriptions, usage, invoicing, upgrades, and billing integrations.  
**API & Integrations**  
Connect your product with the systems your customers already use.  
**AI-powered SaaS Features**  
Agents, copilots, intelligent search, automation, and AI-assisted workflows.  
This is probably the **biggest missing section**.

2\. Development process missing hai  
Potential client naturally sochega:  
**“If I work with Jabitsoft, what happens next?”**  
Add:

From idea to a platform ready to scale.  
01 **Discover**  
Understand the product, users, workflows, and business model.  
02 **Design**  
Define UX, architecture, integrations, and technical foundations.  
03 **Build**  
Develop the product in focused, testable iterations.  
04 **Launch**  
Deploy, monitor, test, and prepare the platform for real users.  
05 **Scale**  
Improve performance, automate operations, and evolve the product as usage grows.  
Ye service page ko much more commercially complete karega.

3\. Tech capability / stack missing hai  
Full giant logo-wall zaroori nahi hai, but some technical credibility helpful hogi.  
For example:

React / Next.js • Node.js • PostgreSQL • AWS / Azure • Docker • APIs • AI/LLMs • CI/CD  
Exact technologies obviously wahi show karo jo Jabitsoft actually supports.
